pdlmi applyFullBoxPreorder

Documents/pdlmi/applyFullBoxPreorder
DirectLPólyaL.applyPolya(p)PutinarL.applyPutinar()Full BoxL.applyFullBoxPreorder()

Purpose

Section titled “Purpose”

Create a new pdlmi that represents the stored residual with the implemented cell-local full box Bernstein-Gram preordering.

Syntax

Section titled “Syntax”

Description

Section titled “Description”

The no-argument form selects the smallest admissible absolute order. The explicit form selects order; it does not add order to the residual degree. Both forms rebuild from C.Residual and C.Relation, return a new object, and leave C unchanged. Reapplication therefore replaces an earlier full-box order, a Pólya selection, or a Putinar selection instead of compounding it.

For a one-parameter residual of degree mmm, the minimum is ⌊m/2⌋\lfloor m/2\rfloor⌊m/2⌋. Even-degree residuals use an unweighted Gram block plus an α(1−α)\alpha(1-\alpha)α(1−α)-weighted block when that block has a nonempty basis. Odd-degree residuals use separate α\alphaα- and (1−α)(1-\alpha)(1−α)-weighted blocks.

For two or more parameters, the minimum is ⌈m/2⌉\lceil m/2\rceil⌈m/2⌉. The certificate contains one Gram term for every subset product of the box generators αs(1−αs)\alpha_s(1-\alpha_s)αs​(1−αs​). A term whose tensor Gram degree would have a negative component is omitted.

For an entry-wise inequality, each MATLAB column-major scalar entry receives an independent scalar certificate. Assembly creates independent Gram variables for every physical cell and every active rate-vertex row. Each present Gram matrix is constrained positive semidefinite, then exact identities match every Bernstein coefficient. For a <= relation, the target coefficients are negated before positive- semidefinite matching; for >=, the residual is matched directly. No implicit positivity margin is added.

For two parameters the four illustrated blocks correspond to the empty subset, each single generator, and their product. In ℓ\ellℓ parameters the same pattern has up to 2ℓ2^\ell2ℓ subset products. The SOS certificate chapter develops the Gram and Markov–Lukács background step by step.

Finite-SDP shape: two parameters, degree three

Section titled “Finite-SDP shape: two parameters, degree three”

For one cell and one active rate row, let the sign-normalized residual have Bernstein coefficients Fi,kF_{i,k}Fi,k​ at tensor degree (3,3)(3,3)(3,3). The default order is r=2r=2r=2, so the residual is exactly elevated to degree (4,4)(4,4)(4,4). The returned constraint list has four PSD Gram constraints, followed by 25 exact affine matrix equalities:

Each Ap,q\mathcal A_{p,q}Ap,q​ is a fixed affine Bernstein-coefficient map of the Gram blocks. For instance,

F0,0=[Q∅](0,0),(0,0),F_{0,0}=[Q_{\varnothing}]_{(0,0),(0,0)},F0,0​=[Q∅​](0,0),(0,0)​,

while

The detailed identity, basis degrees, and Gram dimensions are in the worked two-parameter example.

Arguments And Options

Section titled “Arguments And Options”
InputDescription
CAny pdlmi object. Its stored Residual and Relation are the source for the rebuilt certificate.
orderOptional finite nonnegative integer scalar. It is an absolute full-box order and must meet the dimension-dependent minimum.

Returned Object

Section titled “Returned Object”

Cbox is a new pdlmi with UsePolya=false, UsePutinar=false, UseFullBoxPreorder=true, and FullBoxOrder equal to the selected order. Within each cell and rate row, Constraints stores all PSD Gram-block conditions before the exact coefficient identities. toYalmip(Cbox) returns those stored constraints in the same order.

Deterministic Transcript Example

Section titled “Deterministic Transcript Example”

For the degree-two scalar residual, order one stores two PSD blocks followed by three exact coefficient identities. Order two stores two PSD blocks followed by five identities. The selection made from polya replaces Pólya assembly; it does not use the already elevated constraints.

Validation And Errors

Section titled “Validation And Errors”
  • A malformed order raises pdlmi:InvalidFullBoxOrder.
  • A valid integer below the applicable minimum raises pdlmi:FullBoxOrderTooLow.
  • Semidefinite and entry-wise inequalities retain their original global mode.
  • Equality is direct-only; this method raises pdlmi:UnsupportedEqualityCertificate before validating order.
  • Constructor selection errors are documented on the pdlmi constructor page, including pdlmi:InvalidUseFullBoxPreorder and pdlmi:ConflictingRelaxations.

This method implements the fixed-order full box preordering on each local parameter box. In one parameter it shares the parity-specific Markov–Lukács assembly with applyPutinar. For two or more parameters it is distinct because full box includes every generator-subset product. It is not a general-domain SOS interface, a full-space SOS representation, or an automatic hierarchy selector.
